title: DAds
tagline: Decentralized advertising run by a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO).
description: Online advertisements are primarily centralized. Google owns most of today's online advertising market, with over 7,000,000 users using its service. The project was born as a decentralized advertising protocol using Web 3.0. technologies; to create a democratized ad creation process, easy-to-use UI, and censorship-resistant.
how_its_made: The process is quite simple for the user who wants to create an advertisement campaign; every single piece of data the user inputs will be stored in a smart contract. The image, the advertisement's main characteristic, will be held in a decentralized way using IPFS, with all its metadata.
